Learner: Tenant. Partner: Real estate agent.
Not in this scene: checking in at the office, handing over documents, filling forms, signing a contract, paying money.
must_say: ask about the rent — slot: the flat
ask what is included in the rent — slot: the cost
ask how many rooms there are — slot: the room type
ask whether something is allowed — slot: the thing (a child, a pet)
say who will live in the flat — slot: the person or pet
ask whether there is a problem with something — slot: the thing (noise, light, heating)
ask how far something is — slot: the place (school, metro)
ask whether the flat can be reserved — slot: the flat
must_understand: says the rent, the deposit and what is included
asks who will live in the flat
says the number of rooms and basic features
explains a condition or limitation of the flat
tells you the next step if you want the flat

TARGET_LANGUAGE: Spanish

NATIVE_LANGUAGE: German

LEVEL: Beginner

LEARNER_GENDER: unknown

LEARNER_ROLE: Inquilino / Mieter

topic.description_target: Después de este día, podrá preguntar por el alquiler, las condiciones y las características del piso.
topic.description_native: Nach diesem Tag können Sie nach der Miete, den Bedingungen und den Eigenschaften der Wohnung fragen.

phrases.frame_native: Wie hoch ist die Miete für ___?

partner_lines.text_target: El alquiler son 1.200 euros; la fianza es de dos meses e incluye el agua.
partner_lines.text_native: Die Miete beträgt 1.200 Euro; die Kaution beträgt zwei Monatsmieten, und Wasser ist enthalten.
Wer wird in der Wohnung wohnen?

partner_lines.text_target: Tiene dos habitaciones, un balcón y mucha luz.
partner_lines.text_native: Sie hat zwei Zimmer, einen Balkon und viel Licht.

partner_lines.text_target: Sí. Se exige autorización para ciertos casos.
partner_lines.text_native: Ja. Für bestimmte Fälle ist eine Genehmigung erforderlich.

partner_lines.text_target: Si le interesa, puede presentar la solicitud esta semana.
partner_lines.text_native: Wenn Sie interessiert sind, können Sie diese Woche den Antrag einreichen.

vocabulary.definition_target: The regular payment for living in a flat.
vocabulary.image_prompt: A rental apartment advertisement showing a monthly price

vocabulary.definition_target: To contain something as part of the price or service.
A room in a home.
vocabulary.image_prompt: A bright room inside an apartment

vocabulary.definition_target: To allow something.
To live in a place.
vocabulary.image_prompt: A family living together in an apartment

vocabulary.definition_target: The space between two places.
vocabulary.image_prompt: A map showing the distance between an apartment and a metro station

vocabulary.definition_target: To hold a flat for someone before the final agreement.
vocabulary.image_prompt: A real estate agent marking an apartment as reserved

vocabulary.definition_target: Money paid as security for a rental.
vocabulary.image_prompt: A rental agreement with a security deposit amount

vocabulary.definition_target: A lift that carries people between floors.
vocabulary.image_prompt: An elevator in an apartment building lobby

vocabulary.definition_target: A formal request to rent the flat.
vocabulary.image_prompt: A person completing a rental application at a desk

2. asks who will live in the flat
3. says the number of rooms and basic features
4. explains a condition or limitation of the flat
5. tells you the next step if you want the flat

TARGET_LANGUAGE: Spanish

NATIVE_LANGUAGE: German

LEVEL: Beginner

LEARNER_GENDER: unknown

LEARNER_ROLE: Inquilino / Mieter

PARTNER_ROLE: Agente inmobiliario / Makler

VOCABULARY_COUNT: 8–12

EARLIER_DAYS:
none

PREVIOUS_ATTEMPT_REJECTED_FOR:
- vocab.not_found · v9: «ascensor» occurs in no frame and no partner line

topic.description_target: Podrás preguntar por el alquiler, las habitaciones, las condiciones y la distancia, y decidir si el piso sirve para ti y tu hijo pequeño.
topic.description_native: Du kannst nach Miete, Zimmern, Bedingungen und Entfernungen fragen und entscheiden, ob die Wohnung für dich und dein kleines Kind passt.

phrases.frame_native: Wie hoch ist die Miete für ___?

partner_lines.text_target: El alquiler es de 1.200 euros; la fianza son dos meses e incluye el agua.
partner_lines.text_native: Die Miete beträgt 1.200 Euro; die Kaution beträgt zwei Monatsmieten und Wasser ist inklusive.

partner_lines.text_target: ¿Quién va a vivir en el piso?
partner_lines.text_native: Wer wird in der Wohnung wohnen?

partner_lines.text_target: El piso tiene tres habitaciones, un balcón y mucha luz.
partner_lines.text_native: Die Wohnung hat drei Zimmer, einen Balkon und viel Licht.

partner_lines.text_target: Sí. La reserva mantiene el piso disponible durante tres días.
partner_lines.text_native: Ja. Die Reservierung hält die Wohnung drei Tage für Sie frei.

vocabulary.definition_target: money paid regularly for a home
vocabulary.image_prompt: A rental apartment with a monthly rent notice on a table

vocabulary.definition_target: to have something as part of a price
a room in a home
vocabulary.image_prompt: A bright apartment room with a bed and a window

vocabulary.definition_target: to allow something
to live in a place
vocabulary.image_prompt: A family living together in an apartment

vocabulary.definition_target: unwanted or loud sound
vocabulary.image_prompt: A person covering their ears beside a noisy street

vocabulary.definition_target: a system that heats a home
how far one place is from another
vocabulary.image_prompt: A map showing distance between an apartment and a school

vocabulary.definition_target: money held as security for a rental
vocabulary.image_prompt: A rental agreement beside coins and an apartment key

vocabulary.definition_target: available for use or reservation
vocabulary.image_prompt: An apartment key with an available sign
